q1.q: How soon will I get a response after booking?
q1.a: A dedicated advisor will contact you within 1-2 business days. If inventory or schedule confirmation is needed, we'll inform you of what we can confirm first.

q2.q: Can I consult before deciding on a vehicle?
q2.a: Absolutely. Share your budget, usage and brand preferences, and we'll conduct a pre-purchase evaluation before guiding you through insurance, documentation and delivery preparation.

q3.q: Can I get post-purchase maintenance support?
q3.a: Yes. We provide ongoing consultation for inspection renewal, light maintenance, and servicing. Specific timing and costs are determined per vehicle condition.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Frequently asked questions about our services

q1.q: How do I purchase a vehicle?
q1.a: You can browse our online inventory and select a vehicle, or contact us with your requirements for personalized recommendations. After confirmation, sign the agreement and make payment.

q2.q: Can I inspect the vehicle in person?
q2.a: Yes. Our Saitama showroom welcomes scheduled visits. For overseas customers, we can provide detailed vehicle videos and photos.

q3.a: Ocean freight transit times vary by destination: Southeast Asia 2-3 weeks, Middle East 3-4 weeks, Africa 4-6 weeks, Europe 5-8 weeks, South America 6-8 weeks. Export documentation typically takes 1-2 weeks.

q4.q: What payment methods do you accept?
q4.a: We accept bank wire transfer (T/T), credit card (Visa/Mastercard), and PayPal. All transactions are settled in Japanese Yen.

q5.a: We provide detailed condition reports for all vehicles. Limited warranty may be available for select vehicles upon negotiation. Please consult our advisors for details.

q6.q: Can I specify the destination port?
q6.a: Yes. We support ocean freight to major ports worldwide. Specify your destination port when making an inquiry.

q7.a: Services include pre-purchase evaluation, pre-delivery inspection, basic servicing and repairs, documentation assistance. Specific services can be customized to your needs.

q8.q: What if I'm not satisfied with the vehicle?
q8.a: We provide detailed condition reports and photos before delivery. If there are discrepancies with the description, please contact us promptly for resolution.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Velocity JAPAN takes your privacy seriously. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

collect.title: Information Collection
collect.content: We may collect: name, email address, phone number, country/region, language preference, inquiry content, and browsing behavior. This information is collected only when you voluntarily submit forms or use our services.

use.title: Information Usage
use.content: We use collected information to: respond to your inquiries, provide vehicle recommendations, improve website experience, and send information relevant to your requests. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

protect.title: Data Security
protect.content: We implement reasonable technical and administrative measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, use, or disclosure.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.content: Our website uses cookies to enhance browsing experience, analyze site traffic, and remember your language preferences. You can manage cookies through your browser settings.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: You have the right to view, correct, delete your personal information, or withdraw consent for data processing. To exercise these rights, please contact us through our contact page.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: For any questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at kaiseisg@kaiseisg.com.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using the Velocity JAPAN website and services, you agree to the following terms. Please read them carefully.

service.title: Service Description
service.content: Velocity JAPAN provides Japanese used vehicle display, sales brokerage, and global export services. All vehicle information is subject to actual condition; images and descriptions on the website are for reference only.

pricing.title: Pricing & Payment
pricing.content: All prices are displayed in Japanese Yen (JPY). Final prices may vary due to vehicle preparation, transport costs, and export processing fees. Payment methods include bank wire transfer and credit cards, as confirmed per order.

purchase.title: Purchase Process
purchase.content: The purchase process includes: inquiry → quote confirmation → contract & payment → vehicle preparation → export shipping → delivery. Deposits may be non-refundable if cancellation is due to the buyer.

shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery
shipping.content: We arrange ocean freight shipping from Japan to your designated port. Transit time varies by destination, typically 2-8 weeks. Shipping risks are governed by international cargo transport terms.

warranty.title: Disclaimer
warranty.content: Used vehicles are delivered as-is. We provide no additional warranty unless explicitly stated in the sales contract. We strive for accuracy in vehicle descriptions but do not guarantee absolute condition.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Updated terms will be posted on the website. Continued use of our services constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
